title: DoubleMuon primary dataset in NANOAOD format from RunG of 2016
evidence: Record 30522 is a CMS Run 2016G DoubleMuon NanoAOD collision dataset.
NanoAOD analysis does not require CMSSW and can use ROOT/Python tools.
Validated runs must be applied for analyses that use this collision dataset.

title: DYJetsToLL_M-50_TuneCP5_13TeV-madgraphMLM-pythia8 in NANOAODSIM format
evidence: Record 35671 is the frozen CMS Run 2 NanoAODSIM Monte Carlo companion dataset.
Record 35671 follows the same NanoAOD analysis model as CMS Run 2 NanoAOD collision data.

title: CMS list of validated runs Cert_271036-284044_13TeV_Legacy2016_Collisions16_JSON.txt
evidence: Record 14220 is the validated JSON run/lumisection list for 2016 CMS collision data quality.
Record 14220 states that good luminosity sections should be processed.
For collision analyses tied to record 30522, this validated JSON list is required metadata context.
